blocks.html: The data to create a shipment for an order, along with custom data that's passed to the workflow's hooks.

types.name: CreateOrderShipmentWorkflowInput
types.description: The data to create a shipment for an order, along with custom data that's passed to the workflow's hooks.

children.name: order_id
children.description: The ID of the order to create a shipment for.

children.name: fulfillment_id
children.description: The ID of the fulfillment to create a shipment for.

children.name: created_by
children.description: The ID of the user creating the shipment.

children.name: items
children.description: The items to create a shipment for.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the order's item to ship.

children.name: quantity
children.description: The quantity of the item to ship.

children.name: tracking_number
children.description: The tracking number of the fulfillment label.

children.name: tracking_url
children.description: The tracking URL of the fulfillment label.

children.name: no_notification
children.description: Whether to notify the customer about the shipment.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs related to the shipment.
